source_documents.title: Spontaneously Self-Assembled Naphthalimide Nanosheets: Aggregation Induced Emission and Unveiling a-PET for Sensitive Detection of Organic Volatile Contaminants in Water
Spontaneously Self-Assembled Naphthalimide Nanosheets: Aggregation Induced Emission and Unveiling a-PET for Sensitive Detection of Organic Volatile Contaminants in Water

reference_evidence_units.quote: A simple design strategy of long alkyl chain substitution was formulated to block the detrimental π−π interaction that potentially transforms the aggregation caused quenching (ACQ) chromophores into aggregation induced emission (AIE) active smart nanomaterials.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI
reference_evidence_units.statement: AIE by blocking π-π interactions of the NI cores.

reference_evidence_units.quote: ODNI started aggregating at 40% fw with redshifted intense AIE emission
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI

reference_evidence_units.quote: All these interactions were almost abolished in ODNI-NS indicating the existence of NI cores in an amorphous phase in the NS.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI
reference_evidence_units.statement: π-stacking reflections absent: amorphous NI cores.

reference_evidence_units.quote: with two emission bands at 380 nm and 530-540 nm which could be assigned to ππ transition and excimer emission respectively
reference_evidence_units.subject: NI derivatives

reference_evidence_units.quote: the process of a-PET from electron rich OVCs to ODNI-NS could be involved in the suppression of fluorescence emission.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI nanosheets + xylenes
reference_evidence_units.statement: Acceptor-excited PET from analyte to NI quenches emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The obtained HOMO value for ODNI was −6.565 eV
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI
reference_evidence_units.statement: HOMO ordering permits a-PET from p-xylene/mesitylene.

reference_evidence_units.quote: A steady enhancement in the hydrodynamic diameter of the NS with increasing analytes concentration
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI nanosheets

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: ACQ→AIE is explained by the alkyl chain blocking detrimental π-π interactions of the NI cores (amorphous cores in the nanosheets); a tentative excimer band in DMF.

reannotation.note: Previous primary PET; now AGGREGATE primary (abstract: blocking π-π interactions turns ACQ into AIE). Author decision 2026-11-16: PET between the molecule and an analyte absent from the input goes out of pool, like mechanisms of complexes (§3.4).
